decision_cruda.rationale: Both failures confirmed by radio+CMMS. Repairs likely 13:30/14:30. Central trucks (91 t/h) and the stockpile (174/450 t) have room. LH-09 (1.5 oz/h) goes to C564-14, 0.34 h away: 134 t at 12.1 g/t is about 52 oz, minus about 7 oz of development cost. LH-08 (1.0 oz/h) goes to C512-06, 0.75 h away: about 200 t at 9.2 g/t is about 59 oz, minus about 7 oz. Producing stopes were not touched. Reserves cannot be used because no stope has stopped.
